extension.summary: 显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news:
v1.8.2.1 - Merged upstream v1.8.2 (dvinfo.py, monitor.py, splash.py) onto the 1.8.1.6 custom base; fonts.py, overlay.py, and the skin XML were untouched upstream so all customizations carry over verbatim. v1.8.1.3 - Remote OK/Select while the overlay is open now opens TinyPPI settings (when the header icon is enabled), in addition to mouse/touch on the icon.
v1.8.1.2 - Clicking/tapping the header chart icon now opens the TinyPPI settings (mouse/touch hotspot; remote navigation and player controls unaffected).
v1.8.1.1 - Merged upstream v1.8.1 onto the custom base. - Re-applied: variant-aware speaker/codec block (SDR full + extended background; HDR/HLG below metadata; DV floating top-right); patched fonts.py (NotoSans fix, update-in-place).
